title: NEW Victoria Harbour 75 min Boat Tour with Tour Guide
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the tour that Victoria has been crying out for! We're thrilled to partner with the Greater Victoria Harbour Authority to bring you a wonderful 75 minute cruise on our brand new sightseeing boat that was built in Canada! We cruise through Victoria's Inner Harbour, out past the cruise ships and along the coastline towards Fisgard lighthouse. You'll see and learn about many of Victoria's sights and landmarks with live commentary from local tour guides. Look out for seals on the Brothers Islands and if you're lucky you may see orcas that are often in the area.

Victoria has a rich history and even if you're a local you're sure to learn something new. You're in safe hands with our Transport Canada certified captains and crew members. Enjoy snacks and drinks from the bar and make use of your washroom if the need arises. We' run popular sightseeing boat tours in Vancouver and we're excited to expand your offering to Victoria. Customer service is always your top priority.
